settings.header.subtitle: Settings
settings.page.edge.subtitle: Decide where EdgePilot lives and how present it should be on the desktop.
settings.page.monitor.subtitle: Choose which data from the System module appears in the notch.
settings.page.behavior.subtitle: Set the interface language, how often EdgePilot refreshes and how readily it reacts to the edge.
settings.page.startup.subtitle: Choose how EdgePilot joins the session and when it should shut down completely.
settings.page.about.subtitle: The project, who builds it and the principles it is built on.
settings.edge.position.hint: Choose the edge EdgePilot should emerge from.
settings.edge.screen.hint: The preview follows your choice and shows where the tab will appear.
settings.mode.hint: On hover keeps EdgePilot discreet. Always visible leaves it open. Hidden removes it from the edge until you reopen it from the tray or the settings.
settings.metrics.hint: Click anywhere on a card to turn a metric on or off. The notch resizes itself.
settings.metric.disk.hint: Space used on the chosen volume
settings.language.hint: EdgePilot follows the system language until you choose one here. The change applies at once, without a restart.
settings.language.label: Show the interface in
settings.refresh.hint: A short interval makes the values more responsive. A longer one slightly reduces background work.
settings.refresh.label: Refresh the data
settings.startup.hint: Enable the start for the current user. EdgePilot stays available without launching it by hand at every sign-in.
settings.session.hint: Closes EdgePilot completely, panel and background process included.
about.tagline: Your desktop has edges. EdgePilot makes them useful.
about.summary: An edge-native desktop surface for Windows and Linux, built to show information and actions only when they are needed.
about.author: Author
about.author.name: Created and maintained by @pricootz
about.author.hint: EdgePilot is an independent open source project. Ideas, development, product direction and main maintenance belong to @pricootz, with community contributions through GitHub.
about.local.hint: No account, no mandatory cloud backend and no telemetry uploader.
about.edge.hint: EdgePilot lives on the edge of the screen and aims to reduce traditional windows, dashboards and notifications.
about.evolving.hint: The current preview starts from the system monitor; the next modules will widen the idea without turning it into a generic panel.
about.version.hint: A preview under active development. The APIs, the layout and some features can still change before the first stable release.
